contexts.text: These things... are not necessary to salvation.
Nothing (else) is necessary for souls, that they may enter into Heaven.
By (its repetition) is expressed the necessity... AC 9463.
The essential things of faith, being necessary to salvation, are stated in the letter...
Hence the necessity of the Advent of the Lord into the world...
From which man is spiritually nourished in all necessity...
According to the necessity in the lackings. Signified, Explained.
They had impressed on themselves something concerning fate or necessity... But they were shown that man is free, and (therefore) it is not from necessity. Example(s).
Worldly things are no care to them, except in so far as the necessities of life require. AC 8116.

Everyone must provide for himself the necessities of life. Enumerated... Unless each one procures for himself the necessities of life, he cannot be in a state to exercise charity towards the neighbour...
The frequenting of a place of worship, the hearing of preachings, and prayers, are also necessary things...
Constantly for necessity. Signified, Explained.
By which (words) is signified that the Lord daily provides necessities, and that thus they ought not to be solicitous concerning the acquiring of them from themselves. Explained.
He who views the matter no further than from the sense of the letter, may believe... that necessities are to be expected daily from Heaven... Explained.
From the necessity of order. Heaven is tripartite.
They are carried into this necessity of thinking, from the Divine Itself which inflows...
Good uses are to provide for one's self and one's own the necessaries of life; and to want an abundance for the sake of our Country and the neighbour...
All the necessities of life are given them gratis...
Therefore it is not necessary for man to know more than that he must shun evils as sins, and look to the Lord.

In the most ancient times... there was no other love of riches than that they should possess the necessaries of life... Among the necessaries of their life were also becoming houses, furnished with useful things of every kind, and also garments...
Temporary things... in special relate to the necessities of every man, which are food, clothing, and habitation. These also are put off and left behind by death...
All the laws of the Divine Providence are necessities...
Therefore necessity compels (them to work).
That this is necessary at the end of the Church, in order that some may be saved. Signified.
In this case, fornication... is for him a necessity.
They all bear witness that, through the sun and the earth... the Lord provides all necessities for animate and inanimate things.

Everyone must provide for himself the necessities of life... and many things more which are necessarily required in the civil life in which he is; and this not only for himself, but also for his family; and not for the present time only, but also for the future; (otherwise) he is not in a state to exercise charity...

Men ought to do good to their country from love, according to its necessities, some of which are natural, and some spiritual. Natural necessities regard civil life and order; and spiritual necessities regard spiritual life and order.
He who has faith in the Lord... unconsciously obtains all things which are necessary, and all things which are useful for necessary things.
That there are mere necessities by means of which man is led. Explained.
But they do not appear to man as necessities...
They were informed that they must by no means say other than they think, except from the last necessity.
I perceived... that (men) cannot possibly be led better than they are; so that there are necessities every moment of their lives...
Heaven consists of love, and thence has from the Lord all the Knowledges of faith which are necessary to it...

The punishers are so suddenly present (because) it is necessary for man to sleep in safety... Hence so great a penalty follows from necessity; and (the action of the punishers) is on account of the atrociousness of the wickedness relatively to the necessity.
(Thus) man is led by the Lord by continual necessities to foreseen ends, and still [he is led] by his freedom.

Spirits supposed that all things are accomplished from absolute necessity, and thus that the whole life is a necessity, consequently that the Lord is bound by necessity... But they were shown that they have all freedom, and that if there is freedom there is not necessity, because there are so many contingent things which carry man to the opposite things in freedom. Example(s).
Yet everyone ought to provide for himself and his the necessities and requisites of life from love; but not from the love of self.
All the necessary, useful, and delightful things of life there inflow according to the quality of the use. Defined. Explained.
Those who do the works of their employments solely for the sake of food and the necessaries of life, etc. Described.
